decisions.decision: Freeze an exact Express/router/path-to-regexp oracle profile and route input/output contract. Java API adaptation must preserve observable routing behavior.
Separate raw HTTP route matching and matched-capture decoding from static-file path containment and existing WebSocket extension behavior.
Replace preselected-route plus middleware-list dispatch with immutable ordered layers, explicit Route identity and per-request mount/params/error cursor state.
Introduce logical asynchronous request lifetime; initial handler return is not response completion. Serialize late continuation, rejection, finish, abort and shutdown.

Keep Java 8 bytecode and Android API 21; implement core callback/completion semantics without mandatory CompletionStage, CompletableFuture or kotlinx.coroutines. Optional JVM adapters may map future types.
Preserve source-level extension APIs and regression guarantees; give WebSocket a separate non-Express profile and preserve static confinement, SSE ownership and resource cleanup.
Generalize Servlet AsyncContext lifecycle for deferred ordinary responses; keep SSE pool limits distinct. TinyHttpd currently can wait for completion but consumes its worker.
